n05.descriptionHtml:
One small clear drop. A pear cut cubic zirconia of about 6 x 8mm hangs point up in fine gold tone claws from a tiny bead bail, on a fine cable chain.

STYLING TIP: The everyday drop: wear it daily, or layer it under a longer chain.

Details

  • Stone: Pear cut clear cubic zirconia, approximately 6 x 8mm, in a claw setting
  • Bail: Small round bead
  • Chain: Fine cable chain
  • Length: Approximately 45cm (to confirm)
  • Metal: Gold tone

Care

Keep it dry and away from perfume and harsh chemicals. Wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.
